entities.summary: Richard Alan White is an American lawyer and former politician who served as a member of the United States House of Representatives, representing Washington's 1st congressional district from 1995 to 1999. He is a member of the Republican Party. Rick White was a legal figures from Bloomington (b. 1953-11-06, Bloomington). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
